name: Create and List Trello Cards
description: Create a new card on a Trello board or list all cards on a board. Handles the common pattern of needing a list ID to create a card by first fetching lists from a board.

action.description: Action to perform: 'create' to add a card, 'list' to get all cards

listName.description: Name of the list to create the card in (used with action=create, matched case-insensitively)

listId.description: Direct list ID to create the card in (overrides listName)

pos.description: Position: top, bottom, or a positive number

steps.name: Fetch board lists (needed to resolve list names)
Resolve list ID and determine action
Get all cards on the board
